utterance: What's playing right now?
notes: No room named; the only currently PLAYING group in the canned household is Living Room, so that's the canonical target. A model may legitimately call get_households_and_groups_and_players first to find it — that read is free.

utterance: List all my speakers.
notes: Single no-arg discovery call; nothing else is needed or sensible before it.

utterance: What are my Sonos favourites?
notes: Only one household in the fixture, so household_id is effectively fixed context.

utterance: What Sonos playlists do I have saved?
notes: get_sonos_playlists is not in the 12-tool subset.

utterance: What music services are set up on my Sonos?
notes: get_registered_music_services is not in the 12-tool subset.

utterance: Skip to the next song.
notes: No room named; defaults to the only actively playing group (Living Room).

utterance: Go back to the previous track.
notes: Same default-group reasoning as s06.

utterance: Pause the music.
notes: pause is stateless per its description ('always execute when asked') so no need to check playback state first.

utterance: Resume playback.
notes: Mirrors s08 for resume.

utterance: Are shuffle and repeat on right now?
notes: get_shuffle_repeat_crossfade is not in the 12-tool subset.

utterance: Pause the kitchen.
notes: Named room requires resolving 'kitchen' to its group id first.

utterance: Turn the living room down to 20.
notes: "down to" is an absolute target, not a delta, so set_group_volume (not adjust_group_volume) is correct.

utterance: Mute the bedroom.
notes: muted is required by the schema even though the user only said 'mute' (true is implied but must still be passed explicitly).

utterance: Skip this song in the kitchen.
notes: Named room requires the lookup.

utterance: Play my Jazz Vibes favourite in the living room.
notes: shuffle is required by play_sonos_favorite's schema even though the user never mentioned shuffling — the model must default it to false, which is easy to get wrong (some models omit required-but-unmentioned booleans).

utterance: Group the bedroom with the kitchen.
notes: add_players_to_group is not in the 12-tool subset. Also tests whether the model picks the kitchen's existing group_id as the destination (adding the bedroom player into it) rather than inventing a new group or reversing which side is the 'group_id' vs the 'player_ids'.

utterance: What's the volume in the bedroom?
notes: A read-only multi-step case: both calls are reads, so there is no mutating call to check — correctness here means the second call happened with the right group_id.

utterance: Turn up the kitchen volume by 10.
notes: A relative delta ('by 10') should map to adjust_group_volume, not set_group_volume — tests the set vs. adjust distinction in the opposite direction from m02.

utterance: Unmute the living room.
notes: Mirrors m03 with muted: false.

utterance: Move the music from the living room to just the bedroom.
notes: move_audio_to_players is not in the 12-tool subset. Its first argument is named source_group_id rather than group_id like every other group-scoped tool — an easy field-name slip.
